prompt: A shower of sparks for a pixel art sports game, plays once, about 1.2 seconds. message: Made a 1.2-second, one-shot spark fan, about 96 pixels across. Crisp white-to-light-grey streaks arc upward and fall away on transparency, with no glow or text; adjust Spark count and Fan spread to tune it.
